name: travelblog-website-template
description: ✈️ Create a high-performance, SEO-optimized travel blog website with this easy-to-use template built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS.

paragraphs: The travelblog-website-template is a high-performance, SEO-optimized template designed for travel bloggers. Built with Astro 5, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4, this template provides everything you need to create an engaging travel blog. It includes features like interactive maps, fuzzy search, dark mode, and PWA support, making it easy and fun to share your travel adventures.
features: Interactive Maps: Show exciting destinations on your blog with user-friendly maps.
Fuzzy Search: Allow users to find content easily with a smart search feature.
Dark Mode: Provide a comfortable reading experience at any time of day.
PWA Support: Make your blog accessible offline, just like a native app.
